description: This PHP class 'JobSpecification' extends 'AbstractFileController' and handles file retrieval for job specifications, including fetching attachment details and serving file content based on request parameters within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: JobSpecification
classes.description: Controller class responsible for serving job specification files in the OrangeHRM HR system.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService used to fetch job title related data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to serve a job specification attachment. Retrieves the attachment by ID, sets response headers, and returns the file content; returns a bad request response if attachment is not found.
